description: Permanently delete one or more images from the Nevent media library. Provide the CDN URLs (src / destinationUrl) from nevent_list_images or nevent_upload_image. The operation is irreversible. Any email template HTML that references the deleted URLs will show broken images. Requires FULL operation mode (NEVENT_OPERATION_MODE=FULL) and ADMIN, SUPERADMIN, or OWNER role.

urls.description: Array of CDN image URLs to delete. Use the src/destinationUrl values from nevent_list_images or nevent_upload_image. Minimum 1 URL required. The operation is permanent. Example: ["https://cdn.nevent.es/resources/tenant123/banner.png"].

name: nevent_delete_image
